forage._note: Rolls once from 0 up to (excluding) 100 on forest tiles; each tile can only be foraged once. upTo is a cumulative percentage threshold. World traits multiply each outcome's percentage width; the remainder yields elseResult.

chestLoot._note: Rolls once from 0 up to (excluding) 100. upTo is a cumulative percentage threshold: the first entry with roll < upTo wins. An outcome's chance is its upTo minus the previous upTo; elseResult has the remaining percentage. Guaranteed-artifact chests skip this roll.
